notes: Branded provider tiles with service logos and smooth focus animation. Provider browsing now grows downward in poster grids: independent Load more movies and Load more series buttons, jump links, separate pagination/retry/end states, and no replacement of existing cards. Offscreen poster bitmaps are released for longer browsing sessions. The loading screen stays visible until the native player opens. A new Sources menu selects Movy's advertised playback servers or refreshes the current source while preserving position and play/pause state; cancellation or resolution failure keeps the previous stream. Quality choices remain separate. Native captions, accounts, recent-release views, and update checking remain enabled.
